description: Find the fiscal quarter for any date with any fiscal year start month. Get the FY label, quarter start/end dates and days remaining.

faqs.q: How is the fiscal year labelled?
faqs.a: By the calendar year in which it ends. With an April start, March 2026 falls in FY2026 (April 2025 – March 2026).
January (calendar year), April (UK, Japan, India), July (Australia) and October (US federal government).
Each quarter is exactly 3 calendar months from the fiscal year start: Q1 = months 1–3 of the fiscal year, and so on.

howto: Pick the date you want to classify (defaults to today).
Choose the month your fiscal year starts in.
Read the fiscal year, quarter and exact quarter start/end dates.
See how many days have passed and how many remain in the quarter.
title: Fiscal Quarter Finder
